raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
QUANTIPHI (JULY 2025 – PRESENT) ASSOCIATE ARCHITECT - ML MAIR DATA - POC
Developed a Proof of Concept using Snowflake Cortex Analyst for Mair Group’s sales and inventory data. Built a Streamlit application integrated with a YAML-based schema to enable NLP-to-SQL translation, allowing business users to query data in natural language and receive instant analytical insights without SQL expertise.
RADISYS (APR 2022 – JULY 2025) Lead Data Scientist Jio Voice Assistant
Knowledge Service is a RAG-based open domain question-answering service comprising two parts: Knowledge Graph and LLM Service. Knowledge Graph detects entities from a question, fetch properties, and form answers. LLM Service runs two passage retrievals in parallel, reranks them, and uses the top passage as context to generate short and long answers.
Proposed and implemented a method to retrieve passages using direct full text search from Elasticsearch along with vector search, resulting in a 10% improvement in accuracy.
Improved search result relevance by 8% by conducting a comprehensive benchmarking of re-ranker models (MSMarco, RankT5, Mxbai and BGE) using the MTEB framework and finalizing the top-performing model.
Fine Tuned LLMs (T5, FlanT5, Qwen2.5 and Qwen3) and text-to-text generation model using PEFT (LORA and QLORA) methods to generate both short and long answers from given context, enhancing the response quality, resulting in a 27% improvement in accuracy.
Deployed bert model, embedding model, cross-encoder model and text-to-text generation models (T5 and FlanT5) on Nvidia's Triton Inference Server. Reduced model serving latency by over 90%, achieving inference times in microseconds by transitioning from a standard deployment to vLLM for Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 models.
BioScope
Developed a semantic search capability for movies and TV series to handle complex content search queries, such as searching based on the storyline.
Created a comprehensive context for movies by combining the plot, synopsis, and other data fields from the TMDB and IMDB datasets.
Implemented vector search to retrieve the most relevant movies, followed by filtering based on entities using Elasticsearch and FAISS.
Maintained the existing recommendation pipeline for JIO TV contents.
TRANTOR INC (SEP 2021 – MAR 2022) ML Engineer
Built deep learning based classifier to clean 15M+ articles as part of a relationship intelligence platform.
Developed custom sentence splitter using SpaCy to improve NER and relation extraction.
Designed experiments and tested NLP pipelines for information extraction.
PetThinQ (OCT 2020 – SEP 2021) NLP Engineer
Developed a full text-processing pipeline including cleaning, custom spell-checker, topic modeling, clustering, and summarization.
Built and evaluated sentiment classifier using Transformer based model.
Applied dependency grammar patterns for extracting business insights.
PRIMESOPHIC (JUL 2019 – NOV 2019) ML Intern
Built POC for depression detection using audio-video data and Deep Learning based models.
Implemented face recognition-based attendance system using OpenCV.
ISRO (JUL 2014 – May 2015) Research Intern
Automated multispectral image registration using deep learning approach.
Visualized thermal data from Mars Orbiter Mission payload.
